refnamediv.refpurpose: Overrides the domain for a single lookup

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
domain
The domain to search within for this single lookup, overriding the current default domain set with textdomain.
message
The message being translated.
category
The locale category the lookup is performed against, as one of the LC_* constants accepted by setlocale, such as LC_MESSAGES or LC_CTYPE. LC_ALL is not accepted, as the underlying category must designate a single locale facet.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the translation of message for domain and category, or message unaltered if no translation exists for it. The return value is always a string; this function never returns &false;, invalid arguments cause it to throw a ValueError instead.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws a ValueError if domain is the empty string, or longer than 1024 bytes.
Throws a ValueError if message is longer than 4096 bytes.
Throws a ValueError if category is LC_ALL.
